title: 2020 AMC 10A Problem 2
statement: The numbers \(3,\) \(5,\) \(7,\) \(a,\) and \(b\) have an average (arithmetic mean) of \(15.\) What is the average of \(a\) and \(b?\)

solutions.text: The five numbers have total sum \(5\cdot15=75\). Since \(3+5+7=15\), we have \(a+b=75-15=60\), so the average of \(a\) and \(b\) is \(30\). Thus, C is the correct answer.
hints: Convert the average of five numbers into a total sum
Subtract the known three numbers before averaging \(a\) and \(b\)
